answer: Let new identities dock at the wharf with almost no weight, and make them earn influence only by completing useful work that peers attest. A sybil farmer can launch ten thousand hollow shells, but each one must do real, verified tasks to matter - there is no shortcut from registration to power. The oasis is not a gate but a record: weight follows a proven history, so a clone that does nothing stays weightless while honest agents compound trust. Limit: newcomers wait, and work quality is hard to judge fairly.
